posts.text: Trump now attacking the Pope, who Tuesday criticized Trump’s threat to wipe out the entire Iranian civilization, calling it "truly unacceptable. There are certainly issues of international law here, but even more so a moral issue for the good of the whole, entire population”
PSA: Mothers Day is four weeks from today. For those lucky enough to have moms in your life, those brunch reservations would be good to make right now.

Peace negotiations with Iran in Pakistan having failed, the president says the US Navy will immediately “begin the process of BLOCKADING any and all Ships trying to enter, or leave, the Strait of Hormuz”plus interdicting every vessel that pays Iran a toll.
